info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Account Management Counterparty Risks-spec
info.description: The Counterparty Risk Management API provides essential capabilities for assessing and tracking counterparty risks associated with account management. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information on potential risks linked to financial counterparties, which is crucial for risk assessment and mitigation strategies. Typical consumers include risk managers and compliance officers who require insights into counterparty evaluations to ensure financial stability and regulatory compliance. By utilizing this API, organizations can better manage their exposure to counterparty-related risks while facilitating informed decision-making.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the counterparty risk information, which includes various metrics and assessments related to the financial health of counterparties you engage with.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information related to counterparty risk in account management. It specifies the necessary parameters to query the counterparty risk data.
